title: Face scan

intro.body: About 30 seconds, 6 moves. See how far your face moves and how evenly both sides move.
intro.light: Face a window or a lamp, hair off your forehead.
intro.hold: Hold your iPhone at eye level, about a forearm away.
intro.private: The scan runs on this iPhone. Nothing is sent.
intro.note: It reads movement, not face shape or looks. Not a medical test.

photo.askBody: {{app}} can take one photo of your relaxed face at the start of each scan, so you can compare over time. It stays in {{app}} on this iPhone: never uploaded and not in backups. Delete it anytime.

rest.title: Relax your face
rest.hint: Lips together, eyes on the screen

eyeSquint.title: Squint your eyes
eyeSquint.hint: Narrow them, keep looking at the screen

lipPucker.title: Pucker your lips
lipPucker.hint: Push them forward, like a kiss

mouthOpen.title: Open your mouth
mouthOpen.hint: As wide as is comfortable. Don't force it.

cheekPuff.title: Puff your cheeks
cheekPuff.hint: Fill them with air, lips closed

status.tooClose: Hold the iPhone a bit farther away

simulator: Simulator: a pretend face does the moves

noCamera.title: Camera needed
noCamera.body: Allow camera access for {{app}} in the Settings app to scan your face.

failed.title: The camera stopped
failed.body: The front camera couldn't start. Try again in a moment. (Error {{code}})

noTracking.title: Face tracking isn't working
noTracking.body: The face scan uses the front TrueDepth camera, the same one as Face ID. If Face ID doesn't work on this iPhone, the scan can't run on it either. (Error {{code}})

tooFew.title: Not enough moves read
tooFew.body: Try again with more light on your face, looking straight at the screen.

result.first: Your first scan: this is your starting point. Scan again in about a week, in the same light.
result.howBody: Apple's face tracking on this iPhone reads how far each part of your face moves while you hold each move, compared with your own relaxed face. 100 is a big, full move. Movement is the average of the six moves. Balance compares your left and right side in the brow raise, eye squint and smile (100: both moved the same). Light, distance and effort change the numbers a little, so scan the same way each time. It reads movement only, not face shape, looks or age. Not a medical test.
result.deleteBody: Its numbers and photo are deleted from this iPhone. It still counts as one of your free scans.

card.emptyBody: 30 seconds, 6 moves: see how far your face moves and how evenly both sides move. Everything stays on this iPhone.
card.chartA11y: Chart of your last {{count}} scans. Latest: Movement {{movement}}, Balance {{balance}}.

today.title: Face scan
today.first: 30 seconds to see how your face moves
today.due: It's been a week: time for your face scan

photos.title: Progress photos
photos.empty: No photos yet. With progress photos on, one is taken at the start of each scan.
photos.note: Photos stay in {{app}} on this iPhone. Never uploaded, not in backups. Deleting the app deletes them.
photos.deleteAllBody: The photos are deleted from this iPhone. Your scans' numbers stay.
